segments.t: LINDLEYI Webb & Berthelot, 1840 Synonyms : 异名: Sempervivum lindleyi (Webb & Berthelot) Webb ex Christ (1888) / Sempervivum tortuosum var. lindleyi (Webb & Berthelot) Kuntze (1891) Distribution : Canary Islands 分布:加那利群岛 2 varieties : 名下有2个变种: Aeonium lindleyi var. lindleyi 登天乐 Aeonium lindleyi var. viscatum (Bolle) Liu (1989) 璇铃子P.S.该种为原始种,习性与变种相近,本帖主要介绍其变种.----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- LINDLEYI var. LINDLEYI 登天乐

©Liz21UK Distribution : Canary Islands (NE Tenerife); to 1000 m but most common between 200 and 500 m. 分布:加那利群岛(东北部特内里费岛);海拔1000米内区域,但大多数分布于海拔200 - 500m之间的地区. Description (according to IHSP, 2003) : 描述(根据IHSP,2003): Perennial densely branched shrublets to 50 cm. 多年生群生灌木,成株高度可达50cm. Branches : 3 - 15 mm diameter puberulent, viscid, smooth, without reticulations. 分枝:直径3 - 15mm,被微柔毛,有粘性,光滑,无网纹. Rosettes : 4 - 9 cm diameter, rather flattish, inner leaves ± erect. 莲座:直径4 - 9cm,叶尖持平,内叶大致直立. Leaves : 2 - 4,5 x 0,6 - 1,6 cm, 5 - 7 mm thick, obovate or obovate-spatulate, apically obtuse, acute, or attenuate, basally cuneate or attenuate, puberulent to distinctly pubescent, viscid, yellowish-green to dark green. 叶:长2 - 4.5cm,宽0.6 - 1.6cm,厚5 - 7mm,倒卵形或倒卵状匙形,先端钝,锐尖或渐狭,基部楔形或渐狭,叶被微柔毛到明显短柔毛,有粘性,呈黄色绿色到深绿色. Inflorescences cymose panicles, floriferous part 2 - 7 x 3 - 9 cm, peduncle 1 - 9 cm, pedicels 1 - 10 mm, puberulent. 聚伞状圆锥花序,多花,高2 - 7cm,宽3 - 9cm,总花梗长1 - 9cm,花梗长1 - 10mm,被微柔毛. Flowers 8 - to 9 – merous, sepals pubescent, petals 5 - 7 x 1,5 - 2 mm, narrowly elliptic or lanceolate, acuminate, yellow, filaments glabrous. 花基数8 - 9,萼片被短柔毛,花瓣长5 - 7mm,宽1.5 - 2mm,狭椭圆形或披针形,渐尖,呈黄色,花丝无毛. Cytology : n=18 染色体:n=18 P.S.登天乐有香味.
Plant in cultivation in the south of France. 法国南部的植株 Photos éric Barbier

©carlesjbox Synonyms : 异名: Aeonium viscatum Bolle (1859) / Sempervivum viscatum (Bolle) Christ (1888) / Sempervivum tortuosum var. viscatum (Bolle) Kuntze (1891) Distribution : Canary Islands (E Gomera); ± 100 - 900 m. 分布:加那利群岛(东部戈梅拉岛);海拔大约100 - 900m. Differs from var. lindleyi : 与变种登天乐的不同: Leaves 3 - 4 mm thick, with a dense covering of extremely short multicellular hairs (< 0,04 mm). 也厚3 - 4mm,有密集覆盖的极短的多细胞毛(<0.04mm). Flowers 7- to 9-merous, petals 5 - 7 x 1 - 1,5 mm, lanceolate, acuminate. 花基数7 - 9,花瓣长5 - 7mm,宽1 - 1.5mm,披针形,渐尖. Cytology : n=18 染色体:n=18 P.S.事实上二者的差别还是非常大的,登天乐的叶形更加圆润,而璇铃子则是纺锤状的叶子.
©Daniel Grobbel-RankAeonium lindleyi 一脉以其圆润可爱,绒毛质感的肥厚叶片和其散发出的怡人香气而闻名.再加上小型种天生所具有的魅力,登天乐和璇铃子都是Aeonium中的小王子,深受Aeonium迷的喜爱. 另外,他们也是非常出色的亲本,无与伦比的特性让他们的后代都注定是佼佼者. 资料来源:ICN 有谬误之处敬请指正.
